description:
Let's make okonomiyaki on the Nintendo Switch™!
Cook your okonomiyaki well and make a bunch!
Share Joy-Con™, and up to 4 players can join in!
Reach for the ultimate high score!

《Rules》
Spread the batter, add the meat, and flip once it's cooked.
Then, it's time for toppings!
Work quickly to prevent burning for the most points!
Line up your timing perfectly for an extra bonus!
Make as many okonomiyaki as you can within the time limit!

《How to Play》
1. Spread the batter and add the meat!

2. Once one side is cooked, flip it over!

3. Wait until the other side is cooked!

4. While you're waiting, add sauce, mayo, bonito flakes, and dried seaweed in that order!

5. Once it's done, top it with red ginger and serve it up!

[Score Attack]
Cook up as many okonomiyaki as possible and aim for the top spot on the leaderboards!

[Battle]
Compete with others and test your okonomiyaki-making skills!
name: Make it! Okonomiyaki
